coduri.prag: Without depressing the brake pedal, if the pump operates for more than 15s at a single time and the measured sensor voltage is 1V < U < 2V
coduri.vcu: 1. Transmission curtailment 2. The vacuum pump is in cyclic operation mode, working for 10s each time and stopping for 2s. 3. The power limit is 50% and the speed limit is 60km/h
